title: Dale Crover: The Melvins' Thunder King (Modern Drummer, May 2011 cover story; web post March 2011)
notes: "I learned how to play drums from listening to Kiss Alive! and playing along with that record"; junior high band; lessons from Bob Neisinger, a jazz drummer at Grays Harbor College, for about three years: rudiments from the Haskell W. Harr Drum Method, "Three Camps", then a Carmine Appice book because he wanted to play rock; warms up with rudiments. A 1948 Gretsch kit (24", 13", 16") for recording from the mid-1990s; live "a 26" bass drum, a 16" rack, a 20" floor tom, and a 20" gong bass drum", a Tama Artstar Custom, "the loudest kit I ever had"; then Tama Starclassic Bubinga 24", 15", 18", matching Coady Willis's; "the big sticks"; "You're still playing pretty hard." "Yeah, I try."

title: Bleach: Krist Novoselic Interviews Dale Crover (Seattle Weekly, 27 October 2009)
notes: Into the new wave of British heavy metal in Aberdeen; joined the Melvins after Mike Dillard quit, while still at school; the January 1988 demo at Reciprocal with Jack Endino: "jacked up on coffee for the recording", "We tracked everything live", recorded and mixed in one day, then a show in Tacoma; Aero Zeppelin "takes off faster and faster and almost falls apart, but doesn't".

title: Bullhead (album) - Wikipedia
notes: Melvins' third album, Boner Records, 1991; Buzz Osborne, Lori Black, Dale Crover; produced by Jonathan Burnside. Boris took their name from its first track; Rolling Stone's 100 greatest metal albums, no. 60 (2017).

title: Melvins - Wikipedia
notes: Formed 1983 in Montesano; Dillard left in 1984 and was replaced by Dale Crover, rehearsing at his parents' house in Aberdeen; credited as pioneers of sludge metal and an influence on grunge; Coady Willis a second drummer from 2006 ("He's left-handed, so we want to do this 'mirror image' type of thing"); Dillard back in the 1983 line-up with Crover on bass (2013, 2021).

title: Melvins, "Honey Bucket" (official video, 1993; directed by Steve Payne)
notes: Filmed in a barn among sheep. Crover shirtless at a black Tama kit with chrome hardware and white coated heads, long wavy ginger-blond hair, white shorts and striped tube socks (0:07, 0:26-0:29, 1:18-1:20).
